question: 查询所有有效订单的总销售金额。
intended_meaning: 计算 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的所有记录的 paid_amount 总和。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');

question: 列出所有在售商品的品牌和所属类目。
intended_meaning: 从 products 表中筛选 is_active = 1 的商品，返回其 brand 和 category 字段。
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT brand, category FROM products WHERE is_active = 1;

question: 统计所有有效订单对应的独立付费用户数。
intended_meaning: 统计 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的记录所关联的 user_id 的去重数量。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');

question: 按城市分组，汇总各城市的总销售金额，并按金额降序排列。
intended_meaning: 连接 orders 与 users 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的有效订单，按 users.city 分组，求 orders.paid_amount 总和，并按该总和降序排序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.city, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;

question: 计算所有有效订单中每单平均购买数量。
intended_meaning: 对所有有效订单（order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')）关联的 order_items 记录，求 quantity 的平均值。
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');

question: 找出销售额最高的前5个品牌及其销售金额。
intended_meaning: 连接 orders、order_items 和 products 表，对有效订单的商品行，按 brand 分组汇总 item_amount 总和，取前5名（降序）。
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 列出手机数码类目的商品销售金额及对应已批准退款金额。
intended_meaning: 连接 orders、order_items、products 和 refunds 表，对有效订单且 refund_status='approved' 的记录，按 products.category 分组（限定为'手机数码'），汇总 order_items.item_amount 和 refunds.refund_amount。
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND p.category = '手机数码' GROUP BY p.category;

question: 计算手机数码类目的产品退款率。
intended_meaning: 计算手机数码类目下，已批准退款金额总和除以该类目有效订单商品行 item_amount 总和的比率。
reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND p.category = '手机数码';

question: 统计各类退款原因的出现次数。
intended_meaning: 对 refunds 表中 refund_status = 'approved' 的记录，按 refund_reason 分组计数。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS count FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY refund_reason;

question: 汇总2026年8月每日的有效订单销售金额趋势。
intended_meaning: 对 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 且 order_date 在2026年8月（'2026-08-01'至'2026-08-31'）的记录，按 order_date 分组，求 paid_amount 总和，并按日期升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT order_date, SUM(paid_amount) AS daily_sales FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date <= '2026-08-31' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date;
